summaryZh: Newton 实验室研究细胞信号传导的分子机制，重点是蛋白激酶 C 和磷酸酶 PHLPP，以及其在癌症和神经退行性疾病中的失调。具体方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 细胞如何在分子层面转导信息？

evidence.quote: Skip to content Newton Lab University of California San Diego About Play Our Research Our lab investigates the basic molecular mechanisms of how cells transduce information, a process know as cell signaling. We focus on a key signaling enzyme, protein kinase C , which is generally a little too active in neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s Disease, and not active enough in many cancers. Understanding protein kinase C mechanisms is a first step in developing therapies to restore (cancer) or inhibit (Alzheimer’s Disease) protein kinase C so that it functions normally. We also study the phosphatase PHLPP which has many cellular functions, including opposing protein kinase C signaling. PUBLICATIONS
